text:
alex: Quick flag  PR #4337 swapped the chat examples from 'messages' -> 'inputs' to align with an internal prototype. The published API ref still expects 'messages' (array of role/content objects). This breaks the Node SDK examples in the docs preview and the OpenAPI examples generation. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4337

jamie: Oof. Was that change intentional? The runtime actually requires 'messages'. 'inputs' came from a different spec conversion. We should revert examples in the public docs and keep 'inputs' only in the internal branch.

priya: I noticed the Node snippet used a single string for messages in the example which also confuses readers. We should show the canonical shape: [{"role":"user","content":"..."}]. Also update the Ruby and python snippets while we're at it.

docs-bot: docs-lint failure on PR 4337: openapi/chat.yaml example schema mismatch: property 'inputs' not defined in schema (line 78). SDK generator failed for node-client (error: example payload did not validate). CI: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/4337/logs

alex: Good catch. I'll open a follow-up PR to fix examples and add a migration note. Plan: restore 'messages' in public examples, update code snippets across JS/Ruby/Python, add a short "Why this changed" box showing the internal mapping, and run the SDK generator locally before pushing.

jamie: For the Node snippet, let's use the client helper shape so it's copy-pasteable. Example draft:

```
// Node example
const resp = await client.chat.create({
  model: 'rwd-chat-1',
  messages: [
    { role: 'system', content: 'You are a helpful assistant.' },
    { role: 'user', content: 'Summarize the meeting notes.' }
  ]
});
```

priya: Add a one-line migration callout above the examples: "Previously some internal examples used 'inputs' (string/array). Public API uses 'messages' (array of {role, content})." Also mark any old single-string example as deprecated.

docs-bot: Reminder: update openapi/chat.yaml and docs/reference/chat.md examples in the same commit to keep examples in sync with generated snippets.

alex: Will do. Also adding a tiny test in docs/integration-tests/examples to validate examples against the OpenAPI schema so this doesn't slip through again.

jamie: Sounds good. If you want I can run the SDK generator after you push.

alex: Thanks 44d pushed branch docs/chat-examples-fix and updated files. Local generator checks out OK. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4340/files

priya: Preview site looks correct. Node/Ruby/Python snippets updated. Leaving one nit: inline code fence in the markdown used backticks inconsistently, I left a tiny formatting fix in a suggestion.

jamie: LGTM. Merging after docs-bot verifies generated snippets in CI.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR 4340: example schema validation and SDK snippet generation green.

alex: Merged. Added changelog note under docs/changes: "Fix: chat examples use messages array (role/content); remove accidental 'inputs' examples." Will monitor for downstream SDK consumers in the #support channel.
